use_when: Above the page title on pages that sit inside a hierarchy, such as a listing ("Stays / Portugal / Lisbon / Alfama") or a back office settings page ("Team and roles / Roles / Permissions").
To let the user go back up to any parent page in one click.
Show 2 to 4 levels; hide unused levels with ShowItem2 and ShowItem3.

dont_use_when.when: On top-level pages that have no parent: there's nothing to show.
To show the steps of a flow, such as checkout: use the Stepper component instead.
As the main navigation between sections: use the Sidebar or Header component instead.

a11y.fact: The trail is a native <nav> landmark labelled "Breadcrumb", containing an ordered list; the label can be overridden through the passthrough props.
The current page is the last list item, a non-link <span> marked aria-current="page".
The "/" separators are aria-hidden so assistive technology does not announce them.
Each ancestor is a native <a>, so keyboard focus, the focus ring and activation are the browser's own; no focus style is overridden.
